question: ______ is used to get rid of indigestion.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Antacid.**____**​**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Antacids **are medicines that neutralize the acid in human stomach to** relieve indigestion and heartburn.**
 
• They serve by **neutralizing the stomach acid** that give rise to heartburn.
 
• This treatment is utilized to **treat the symptoms of too much stomach acid such as stomach upset, heartburn, and acid indigestion.**
 
• It is as well served to relieve symptoms of extra gas such as** belching, bloating, and feelings of discomfort in the stomach.**

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Antibiotics** are **medicines that control bacterial infections in humans and animals**. 
 
• They serve by** killing the bacteria** or by making it hard for the bacteria to develop and multiply.
 
• **Analgesics** are **medications that relieve various kinds of pain** from headaches to injuries to arthritis. 
 
• An** antiseptic** is **a substance that controls or slows down the development of microorganisms**.
